components.adaptation_rationale: Retain MIT notice on substantial reuse. Do not import fixed 80% threshold, stack assumptions, value-printing secret scans or pipeline failure masking.
Same family as ECx; prefer one ANDES procedure. ECC improves pipeline handling but retains universal coverage and value-printing scans.
Overlaps ECC; checkpoint commits and mandatory coverage are not ANDES defaults. No personal runtime/evaluator adoption.
Use behavioral failing-first principle only; reject universal coverage and blanket approval/checkpoint requirements.
Proportionate alternative designs are useful; arena is a referenced dependency, deferred in ANDES.
Evidence pointers useful; do not adopt transcript ingestion, mandatory cross-vendor review, append-only TSV as canonical evidence contract, or automatic logging of private data.
Behavioral tests and vertical slices fit; mandatory seam reconfirmation and deferring all refactoring to review are not adopted.
Decision/frontier separation useful; custom tracker and label conventions not needed for foundation.
